name: Harness reads healing power, swim speed, skill bonus and casting regeneration of a Witch Doctor
contract: ADR 1030 (provisional) adds the reads healing_power (Unit::SpellBaseHealingBonusDone), swim_speed_rate
(Unit::GetSpeedRate(MOVE_SWIM)) and skill_bonus (the permanent plus temporary bonus of a skill line), and the
conformance tool judges mana_regen_interrupted as a share of mana_regen. Each read is shown without and with
the aura that moves it: Spirit Healer 560280 (aura 175, 40% of Spirit as healing power, truncated), Natural
Alchemist 536213 (aura 98, Alchemy 171 +15), Ingredient: Fish Oil 801662 (its area aura 803269 carries aura 58,
+10% swim speed) and Spiritual Traditions 705911 (aura 134, 40% of the regeneration while casting).
